name: Hip Extension
instructions: Lie face down on a bench or the floor with hips at the edge if on a bench.
Keep your torso stable and brace your core.
Raise your straight leg or legs until they are in line with your body.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
longevityNotes: Hip-hinge strength protects the lower back in every lift, from groceries to grandchildren. Strong glutes and hamstrings are the engine of walking, climbing, and standing up.
overview: A floor or bench exercise that extends the hips to train the glutes and lower back.

safetyNotes: Stop at a straight line; skip with acute low-back pain.
